known.title: The contract says that omp maps the effort med to one level below the top level
known.summary: plan-contract.md:184-186 tells the manager to dispatch a plan delta round with `effort: med` and says that omp maps `med` one level below the model's top level. The omp task tool documentation (`omp://tools/task.md`, Inputs, which the plan's Research cites) says that `effort` is "mapped onto the resolved model's supported range (lowest/middle/highest level it tops out at, e.g. `high`/`xhigh`/`max`)", so `med` is the middle level of the range. The probe gave `high` for `gpt-6.1-sol` at `xhigh` only because of the range of that model. For a model whose range ends at `max`, or for a plan reviewer configured below its top level, `effort: med` gives the same or a higher effort than round 1, against plan decision 9 (a delta round one level lower). The results log entry (results.md:776) gives `effort: med` as the lower effort without this limit.
